results.title: Europiano (1/2) - The finest piano concertos from across Europe
results.original_title: Europiano (1/2) - The finest piano concertos from across Europe
results.overview: To mark Music Day, ten European orchestras will perform some of the finest piano concertos alongside prestigious soloists and under the baton of renowned conductors from various cities across the continent. The programme for this exceptional concert features works by Brahms, Grieg, Chopin, Beethoven, Ravel and Mozart.

results.title: Boatbuilders
results.overview: Over the course of 16 months, at the head of a remote harbor in Maine, the workers of the Brooklin Boat Yard meticulously build a 56-foot wooden sailboat. As the seasons change and the vessel takes shape, director Luke Lorentzen immerses the viewer in a close-knit community rooted in time-honored craft, shared joys, and mutual respect.

results.title: Vadh 2
results.overview: A police officer's pursuit of truth in a shocking prison crime intertwines with the lives of a widowed prison guard and a soon to be released inmate, unravelling a web of morality and redemption.

results.title: Kill Me
results.overview: Jimmy wakes up in a bathtub after having tried to kill himself. Or, at least, that’s what it looks like to his friends and family. Jimmy is pretty sure he didn’t do it… maybe. Together with Margot, the 911 operator who took his call, Jimmy sets out on a mission to solve a vitally important whodunit: did someone try to kill him, or are they chasing the spectre of depression?

results.title: Na Jaane Kaun Aa Gaya
results.overview: A love triangle. From Kaushal's breaking world to Tina's silent emotional conflict and Veer's transparent and blunt love, three hearts navigate guilt, longing, and impossible choices.

results.title: Ernie & Emma
results.overview: A pear salesman is left with some amusing duties and an urn of ashes after losing the love of his life.

results.title: Beast
results.overview: After a final harvest forced upon him by the landlord, an old farmer and his loyal carabao embark on a magical road trip to Manila, chasing the ghost of a niece the years stole from him.

results.title: Saturday Night's Main Event XLV
results.overview: Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk joins forces with Cody Rhodes against Gunther and Sami Zayn, Danhausen competes in his first match at Madison Square Garden as he takes on JD McDonagh in a No Disqualification Match, and WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Paige and Brie Bella defend their title against Lainey Reid and Fallon Henley of Fatal Influence.

results.title: Echoes
results.overview: Alba spends her days shut away in her apartment. Amidst oppressive silences and sudden outbursts of anger, her mind drifts ceaselessly between the present and the past.

results.title: My Daughter Was Taken
results.overview: After witnessing her daughter's abduction during a video call, a former prosecutor races home from Spain, only to become the next target. Hunted by someone who thinks she saw too much, she must risk everything to stay alive... and save the one person she can't live without.

results.title: Someone Else's Call
results.overview: The early 2000s. Young Natasha is torn between the pressure of her rational parents, determined to send her to law school, and her dreams of entering the Academy of Arts in St. Petersburg. A new classmate, the gifted musician Igor, helps her believe in herself and take a risk. The young people fall in love. Years later, Natasha and Igor meet by chance at an exhibition of her paintings. This brings them back to memories of their happy times.

results.title: Horsegirls
results.overview: As her mother battles an uncertain diagnosis, neurodivergent 22-year-old Margarita discovers a source of strength in an unexpected place: the sport of hobbyhorsing.

results.title: Bluebird
results.overview: One night, while working as a handyman at a bizarre medical facility, a lonely man named Charles meets a young woman named Chloe. The two share an immediate connection as she recounts having met him in a dream. When Chloe disappears, Charles sets out to find her in a strange world that seems intent on keeping them apart.

results.title: Dialing Death
results.overview: Three mischievous teenagers pull what they think will be a harmless prank - a late-night phone call to a random number, pretending they know dark secrets about the man on the other end. What they don't realize is that they've just called a notorious serial killer who's been lying low, and now he believes they actually know something that could expose him.

results.title: Elder Son
results.overview: Lila, a young Korean-Argentinean girl, navigates the contradictions of her identity and tries to find her place in the world. Her father, Antonio, arrives in Latin America 18 years earlier, and decides to bet everything on the promise of a young immigrant's dream.

results.title: Ein Münchner im Himmel - Der Tod ist erst der Anfang
results.original_title: Ein Münchner im Himmel - Der Tod ist erst der Anfang
results.overview: When cab driver Ludwig “Wiggerl” Brunner, a true Munich bon vivant, is hit by a streetcar and ends up in heaven, there is only one way back to his beloved Bavaria: he has to improve his karma balance as quickly as possible.

results.title: Vibby
results.overview: Rowan is left in an emotional tailspin when her beloved vibrator, Vibby, unexpectedly passes away. Unable to cope, Rowan turns to her best friend, Andy, for support.

results.title: Ziggurat
results.overview: A leader obsessed with progress into the skies, nears the culmination of his work.
